details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/security_audit.sh:1511-1517, cross_file_guard_deletion_pattern | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The cross-file guard deletion detector does not recognize common authorization predicates such as has_access(user), has_permission(user), user.can_view, or user.may_edit.
  WHY: Deleting such a guard in one file while leaving the privileged sink unchanged in another sets cross_file_guard_deleted=false, causing a project-introduced access-control bypass to be classified as a non-blocking advisory.

- .github/workflows/implement.yml:3400-3403 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The generated-advisory scope guard does not normalize unexpected validator exit codes to the fail-closed code before dispatching the case statement.
  WHY: Validator crashes, missing interpreters, or other unexpected exits reach the warning-and-continue branch, allowing generated advisories to commit changes outside the exact cited file; severity disagreement: none.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:497-500 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The commit-time generated-advisory scope guard does not normalize unexpected validator exit codes to the fail-closed code before dispatching the case statement.
  WHY: Validator failures reach the warning-and-continue branch, bypassing exact-path and authorship enforcement for generated advisories.

- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:214-218 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: extract_plan_files() recognizes only ATX headings even though the canonical plan format uses numbered sections.
  WHY: A canonical generated-advisory plan produces plan_files=[], so the exact-file check rejects every legitimate generated advisory before implementation.

- scripts/security_audit.sh:2012-2013, 2024-2033 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Marker extraction uses non-anchored regular expressions and .search(), allowing markers embedded anywhere in an issue body to be treated as authoritative.
  WHY: Model-controlled prose can inject arbitrary marker IDs or keys and suppress distinct security findings during follow-up deduplication.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5787-5791 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The jq reconciliation query matches advisory markers anywhere in the issue body instead of requiring their canonical generated-header position.
  WHY: Injected markers in quoted evidence or model prose can be treated as canonical and suppress creation of a real follow-up issue.

- scripts/security_audit.sh:2114 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The advisory's imperative task sentence interpolates unvalidated model-controlled owasp_or_stride_category text.
  WHY: Crafted category text can become authoritative implementation instructions, enabling prompt laundering.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:line 5877 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The poller-side advisory-body builder interpolates model-controlled owasp_or_stride_category text into the imperative task sentence.
  WHY: Crafted category text becomes authoritative implementation instructions in generated advisory bodies.

- tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py:_run_fragment() helper, lines 323-369 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Regression coverage for generated-advisory validator failure does not exist.
  WHY: A future fail-open scope-guard path can pass the test suite because no test exercises a crashing helper with generated_security_advisory=true.

- tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py:search for test_generated_advisory_plan_parser_accepts_numbered_contract — absent | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Regression coverage for numbered canonical plan sections is absent.
  WHY: The parser can regress to ATX-only behavior without CI detecting it.

- tests/test_security_audit_workflow_contract.py:line 429 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The contract test still asserts the old non-anchored marker regex.
  WHY: A future regression dropping canonical-position anchoring would pass the existing test.

- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:search for test_security_pass_advisory_followup_ignores_injected_remote_marker — absent | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Regression coverage for rejecting injected remote advisory markers is absent.
  WHY: A future regression accepting markers embedded in arbitrary body text would pass the existing tests.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:lines 5827-5834 (prose() helper used by advisory body builder) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: prose() does not strip or escape HTML comments before model-controlled text is included in advisory bodies.
  WHY: Model-controlled exploit_scenario text can mint marker-looking HTML comments that the deduplication logic may treat as authoritative.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Validate clean-pass rebinding through deterministic merge-tree equality or trigger re-audit." (Issue #4173 mitigation-policy summary, applied to scope validation through planning)
  expected_change_site: scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py extract_plan_files() — function at lines 209-230
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py lines 214-230 still recognize only ATX headings; tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py lacks test_generated_advisory_plan_parser_accepts_numbered_contract

- requirement: "Implement each mitigation as an automated, deterministic control ... fail-closed validation, least-privilege tokens" (Issue #4173 mitigation policy applied to scope-validator failure modes)
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/implement.yml preflight scope guard (around line 3397-3403) and scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh commit scope guard (around line 494-500)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: .github/workflows/implement.yml and scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh lack the generated-advisory normalization block; tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py lacks test_generated_advisory_helper_failure_fails_closed

- requirement: "Prevent ... waiver-ID collisions" (Issue #4173 mitigation-policy summary, also enforced through the canonical-marker reconciliation listed in the LAST_RUN commit)
  expected_change_site: scripts/security_audit.sh marker_regex, key_marker_regex, generated_footer_key_regex definitions around line 2012-2020
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: scripts/security_audit.sh lacks the anchored marker_regex, key_marker_regex, and generated_footer_key_regex; tests/test_security_audit_workflow_contract.py line 429 still checks the OLD non-anchored pattern

- requirement: "Prevent prompt laundering" (Issue #4173 mitigation-policy summary applied to advisory issue bodies)
  expected_change_site: scripts/security_audit.sh body_lines builder at line 2114 and scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh advisory body builder at line 5877
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Both files still interpolate model-controlled category text into the imperative sentence and neither adds a > Category: line in the quoted evidence block; tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py at lines 4459-4462 and tests/test_security_audit_workflow_contract.py at line 513 lack the prompt-laundering coverage

- requirement: "Generated advisory markers must be validated against canonical position to prevent prompt injection"
  expected_change_site: scripts/security_audit.sh:2012-2033, scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5787-5791
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The marker extraction uses .search() and contains() anywhere in the issue body, without canonical-position validation

- requirement: "Generated advisory scope validation must fail closed when the validator is unavailable"
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/implement.yml:3400-3403, scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:497-500
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: Unexpected exit codes 1, 126, and 127 fall through to warning-and-continue branches instead of being normalized to 30

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/security_audit.sh:1511-1517, cross_file_guard_deletion_pattern | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The cross-file guard deletion detector does not match common authorization predicates.
  WHY: Deleting if has_access(user): in auth.py while changing only an unrelated line in views.py results in cross_file_guard_deleted=false, so the access-control bypass becomes a non-blocking advisory.

- .github/workflows/implement.yml:3402-3403 (between rm -f scope_staged_file and case scope_rc in) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The normalization block for unexpected validator exit codes is absent.
  WHY: A Python crash or import error returns exit code 1, which the existing case statement routes to the warning-only branch and bypasses exact-file scope enforcement.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:499-500 (same gap as above) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The commit-time scope guard has the identical missing normalization block.
  WHY: An unexpected validator exit code reaches the warning-only branch and the commit proceeds without scope enforcement.

=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:extract_plan_files() at lines 209-230 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The plan parser only matches ATX headings, while the canonical plan format uses numbered sections.
  WHY: A canonical generated advisory plan returns plan_files=[] and is rejected by the exact-file check.

- .github/workflows/implement.yml:lines 3397-3403 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The generated-advisory scope guard lacks normalization for unexpected helper exit codes.
  WHY: A crashing helper or an exit code of 10 reaches a branch that logs and continues, bypassing exact-path and authorship checks.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:lines 494-500 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The commit-time scope guard has the same missing normalization defect.
  WHY: A validator failure can fail open for generated advisories.

- scripts/security_audit.sh:line 2012 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: marker_regex is non-anchored and uses [^>]+.
  WHY: A marker embedded anywhere in legacy issue prose can populate existing_finding_ids and suppress a distinct keyed finding.

- scripts/security_audit.sh:line 2114 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The imperative task sentence interpolates model-controlled owasp_or_stride_category text.
  WHY: Crafted category text becomes an authoritative implementation directive.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:line 5877 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The advisory-body builder interpolates model-controlled category text into the imperative task sentence.
  WHY: Crafted category text becomes authoritative implementation instruction.

- tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py:_run_fragment() helper, lines 323-369 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The claimed helper_source parameter and test_generated_advisory_helper_failure_fail
